messages:
nina.k: flagging a noisy pattern from this morningleads switching owners after rapid HubSpot retries + late enrichment. opening thread to propose a short-term circuit-breaker.

omar: can you paste a tiny sample? looks similar to what we fixed last month but not identical.

nina.k: sample: 08:12:01 lead-999 -> owner1, 08:12:07 lead-999 -> owner2, 08:12:20 lead-999 -> owner3, enrichment returned 08:12:58. webhooks show duplicate delivery id on two attempts.

kelly: seems like two failure modes: duplicate webhook deliveries (HubSpot retries) and our rotation re-evaluating on every update. both cause churn.

ops-bot: telemetry: webhook_retry_rate spike at 380/s during 08:10-08:15; claim-service errors 0.4% last 15m.

jon.p: short-term: introduce a circuit-breaker rule in routing: if a lead receives >2 assign events within 90s, mark it "circuited" and hold further rotation for 3m while routing to a temporary overflow queue for manual review. low-risk and reversible.

nina.k: love it. Pseudocode:```if lead.assign_count(window=90s) > 2:
  mark lead.circuited=true
  route to overflow_pool
  set hold_until = now + 180s
```

omar: couple notes: 1) make sure VIP/paid leads bypass circuiting. 2) surface a lightweight ticket in #support with lead id + reason so SDRs can follow up quickly.

kelly: also add a short-lived flag on the lead so when enrichment arrives we can re-evaluate after hold expires rather than immediately re-run rotation. avoids double work.

ops-bot: automation: created alert rule -> #support when assign_count > 2 within 90s for a lead.

jon.p: plan: nina will add config toggle + overflow route, omar will add support ticket payload, kelly will update rotation to check circuit flag. staging smoke: 20m synthetic with webhook replay. canary: 5% traffic tomorrow 9:30am PT.

nina.k: I'll open a small PR with tests and rollout notes. ETA PR by EOD. tagging @omar @kelly for review.

omar: will add idempotency header handling in webhook path too, helps reduce the root cause.

kelly: will write unit tests for circuit flag and VIP bypass. also add metric: circuited_leads_count and time_in_circuit.

nina.k: thanks everyone. if smoke passes we'll flip the toggle during low traffic window and monitor assigned_owner_entropy and circuited_leads_count. :raised_hands:
